statement.p: A painting is on sale at {\$595.00}. Its original price was {\$700.00}. What percentage is this off its original price?
The painting was off its original price.

solution.p: The price changed from {\$700.00} to {\$595.00}, implying the markdown was {\$700.00} - {\$595.00} = {\$105.00}.
Now this problem can be boiled down to this question: 105 is what percent of 700? We will show multiple methods to solve this problem.
We will use proportion to solve this problem.
Assume 105 is x\% of 700, so x out of 100 corresponds to 105 out of 700.
We will write and solve the proportion:
The painting was 15\% off its original price.
We will use the percentage formula to solve this problem.
This translation from English to may should help you remember the percentage formula.
Assume 105 is x (as a percent) of 700. We have:
The painting was 15\% off its original price.
In the sentence 105 is what percent of 700,

li.p: 700 is the base (following the word of).

solution.p: By the formula \text{rate} = \frac{\text{percentage}}{\text{base}}, we do a division to solve the problem:
The painting was 15\% off its original price.
